entities.summary: Davit Chaloyan is an Armenian boxer. He competed at the 2021 AIBA World Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the super heavyweight event. He also competed at the 2025 IBA Men's World Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the same event.
